name: tui-compact
description: Auto /compact in the interactive TUI before the 5-hour quota runs out (Windows, Pro/Max). Pair it with autoContinueAtUsageLimit.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: inject: type /compact into the TUI for you. notify: only show a warning asking you to run /compact.

compact_at_percent.title: Compact at 5h quota %
compact_at_percent.description: Compact once the 5-hour quota reaches this percentage.

min_compact_tokens.title: Minimum context tokens
min_compact_tokens.description: Below this context size nothing is compacted, because resuming a small context is cheap.

compact_instructions.title: Compact instructions
compact_instructions.description: Text passed to /compact: what to keep.
compact_instructions.default: Keep: the main goal, decisions already made, the list of modified files, current errors, and the remaining steps in order.

continue_prompt.title: Continue prompt
continue_prompt.description: Typed after a compact that interrupted a running task.
continue_prompt.default: Continue the unfinished work from where you stopped, following the original goal.
